facts.fact: L'express says security settings provided for by the Data Protection Act will be built into the One Patient, One Record system, treating the Act as the law in force.

L'express reports the Digital Health Company Ltd, a public company under the Ministry of Health and Wellness, holds overall responsibility for the eHealth project, with UNDP support for One Patient, One Record.
L'express reports staff training on One Patient, One Record has begun at Flacq hospital and will extend to other hospitals, and the company is recruiting staff.

MUS.note: Document describes a patient record project, not a national reporting system.
